note: Set A is more complete, extracting both x2 and x3 coordinates for most points (SC, NA, CG, GC), whereas Set B misses x2 coordinates for SC and NA. However, both sets suffer from duplicates and conflicting values for the same attributes (e.g., Set A lists CG x2 as both -0.15 and -0.2; Set B lists NA x3 as both 0.05 and 0.0). Set A is preferred for capturing the SC x2 position correctly (0.1 m) which B omits, though A misreads the NA position.
remarks: Both sets struggle with the small plot text, leading to OCR errors and conflicting extractions. Set B's internal contradictions on coordinate values (claiming 0.0 and 0.05 for the same axis) reduce reliability. Set A's inclusion of 'material' and 'material layer' claims creates unnecessary duplication.
